name: Dan Brunski
current_role: Co-founder and President, Citra (Citra Space Corporation, space domain awareness, Colorado Springs); co-founder and former CTO of True Anomaly
profile: Electrical engineer and former Air Force space operator who co-founded True Anomaly in 2022 with Even Rogers, Kyle Zakrzewski and Tom Nichols after they served together in the 4th Space Operations Squadron; he was its first CTO. In 2024 he and Nichols left to co-found Citra, a veteran-owned company building telescopes, antennas and software for space domain awareness, where he is President.
interesting_fact: True Anomaly's founding thesis took shape in 2018 when Brunski and Even Rogers were working on a national-security space effort and ran into the limits of DoD bureaucracy; Rogers calls him 'a brilliant tactician, a gifted scientist' with 'a refreshingly dark sense of humor.'
deep_cut_fact: His new company Citra builds its own engines, including 'keplime', a high-performance orbital-mechanics package, and 'pixelemon', a high-speed image-processing engine for space-object tracking.
notes: No longer at True Anomaly (left Aug 2024 per Contrary Research: https://research.contrary.com/report/true-anomaly); presumably retains founder equity. Reach via Citra rather than True Anomaly.
